Indian Engineer Faces Joblessness and Financial Hardship in US

An Indian engineer, educated at IIT and with 20 years of experience in the US, is reportedly facing significant career and financial difficulties. The engineer, identified as Gautam, is 60 years old and has been struggling to find employment in the US for two years, leading to a situation where he had to ask for money. One report states a single wrong decision at age 60 led to his career being ruined.
